title: Ostomy Supply Program Cost-Share Schedule by Payer Tier
content:
The Ostomy Supply Program bills every program on the payer tier fixed by the coverage it bills, and each tier carries its own patient cost-share terms. The schedule below is the cost-share basis for all six tiers.

## Terms of the schedule

- **Coinsurance** is the patient coinsurance as a percent of the payer-allowed amount on each claim line after any deductible; on the self-pay tier it is the share of the Larkfield cash price the customer pays. It is stated as a whole percent.
- **Copay per 30-day supply** is the flat patient copay the plan applies per 30-day supply on a claim line, in USD; 0.00 means the plan applies no copay. It informs the expected patient responsibility that the payer remittance confirms.
- **Deductible applies** states whether the plan's annual deductible applies to this product line before coinsurance. The deductible amount itself is the payer's and arrives on the remittance.
- **Crossover to secondary** states whether the patient responsibility left by the primary payer is automatically crossed over to an in-effect secondary coverage before any patient statement.
- **Liability notice form** is the advance notice of financial liability a customer must sign before an item or quantity expected to be denied can be billed to them.

## Schedule

| Tier | Coinsurance | Copay per 30-day supply | Deductible applies | Crossover to secondary | Liability notice form |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ostomy Self-Pay Program | 100% | USD 0.00 | No | No | Not applicable |
| Ostomy Commercial HMO Program | 0% | USD 35.00 | No | No | The plan's member waiver |
| Ostomy Commercial PPO Program | 20% | USD 0.00 | Yes | No | The plan's member waiver |
| Ostomy Medicare Advantage Program | 20% | USD 0.00 | No | No | Organization determination required |
| Ostomy Original Medicare Program | 20% | USD 0.00 | Yes | Yes | CMS Advance Beneficiary Notice of Noncoverage (form CMS-R-131) |
| Ostomy Medicaid Program | 0% | USD 0.00 | No | No | Medicaid non-covered service agreement |

## Reading the schedule

- The Ostomy Commercial HMO Program is the only tier with a copay: USD 35.00 per 30-day supply, with 0% coinsurance.
- The plan's annual deductible applies before coinsurance on two tiers only, the Ostomy Commercial PPO Program and the Ostomy Original Medicare Program.
- Automatic crossover of the primary payer's patient responsibility to an in-effect secondary coverage happens on the Ostomy Original Medicare Program alone.
- On the Ostomy Self-Pay Program the customer's share is 100% of the Larkfield cash price, and no liability notice form applies.

*Illustration (hypothetical figures):* on a tier with 20% coinsurance, a claim line whose payer-allowed amount is USD 50.00, with no deductible remaining, carries an expected coinsurance of USD 10.00 (20% of USD 50.00); the amount actually owed is the patient responsibility the payer remittance shows.
